pattern.comment: High-passed filtered breakbeat for the intro and build-up
pattern.label: filteredDrums

pattern.comment: 1. Intro: Atmospheric pad, deep vocal, and high-passed drums (4 bars)
pattern.label: intro

pattern.comment: 2. Build-up: Snare roll accelerates while filter opens up (4 bars)
pattern.label: buildSection

pattern.comment: 4. Breakdown: Drums cut out completely; spacious pads and vocal take over (4 bars)
pattern.label: breakdown

vocalIntro.comment: 1. Pitched-down atmospheric vocal phrase for the intro & breakdown
vocalIntro.label: vocalIntro

pattern.comment: 2. Rapid-fire, chopped ragga/jungle-style vocal stabs for the drop
pattern.label: vocalStab

drop.comment: 3. Drop: Full-weight 174 BPM drums, sub/Reese bass, and dub vocal stabs (8 bars)
drop.label: drop
